title: Favourite trombonists and not playing with the marching bands
summary: He did not play in the Tuxedo or Onward bands; admired Moise French and a trombonist with Clayton.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Did you ever play at the Tuxedo Brass Band? Not in them days, no. Or the Onward Brass Band, Emmanuel Perez, ever? No, I didn't play with them. I might ask, we only have another minute or so on this tape, but who were your favorite trombonists? You mentioned Frankie Doosan, and any others that you liked real well?

Yeah, I got a couple of young fellas under them, a little fella by the name of Moise French, used to play with Rene. I've heard of him, I never knew him. Yeah, I find he was a sweet little trombone player. We had another little fella that you played some nice trombone. He used to play with a little fella that's called Clayton. I forget that boy name. Did you ever interview Clayton? No, not yet. We'll do that pretty soon. Yeah, well. I know him very well.
He had a little trombone player. I've come up wrong in my class. I find he was pretty good. Clayton will tell us about him when we talk to you. Yeah.
